Mia thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. Sam's birthday is in June. Mia wrote about the day in the diary. Grandma made rice pudding for the winter festival.
The moon-lit yard is one of the best places in the city. Mia learned a lot about music. Life is full of small surprises. For example, I only had a sandwich for lunch.
There are always many people at the dragon boat river. Mia and Sam had great fun there. Both of them like dumplings and water. An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
Mia is reading a book about music. Mia hopes to visit Chengdu one day. Mia wants to be a driver in the future.
